8ffbbd69e7.q: What problem did Davisware solve for heating and air conditioning service companies?
8ffbbd69e7.a: Davisware solved the core logistical problem of trades: getting the right person to the right place at the right time with the right parts and skills. The software replaced manual T-card dispatching systems with integrated dispatch boards, billing, inventory, GPS, and accounting systems. Jennifer Davis emphasized focusing on first-time fix rates by building massive databases to match technician skill sets and truck inventory with predicted customer problems based on equipment models.

2130821513.q: What industries did Davisware expand into beyond HVAC?

The company targeted industries with complex parts having serial numbers, regulatory requirements, and high stakes for error—food equipment service where mistakes cause illness, petroleum equipment where mistakes cause explosions. 319a18f1cd.q: What remote work and company culture practices did Davisware implement early?
319a18f1cd.a: Davisware hired its first remote employee in 1991, decades before remote work became standard, which created a decade-long tax dispute between Illinois and Ohio. The company required cameras on for all meetings with two or more people, and required phone calls instead of email chains after three consecutive emails. They held annual user conferences where every employee attended, closing support lines to emphasize company mission and culture.
